headline: Sensex recovers from 700-point plunge as Pharma and Metals offset losses in IT stocks; NCC and Power Mech rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sharp initial sell-off led to a 700-point drop in the Sensex and a breach of the 22,600 level on the Nifty
Significant selling pressure in major IT stocks including TCS, Wipro, and Infosys, which fell up to 2%
Recovery driven by buying interest in the Pharma and Metal sectors as the Sensex bounced back 600 points from its low
Positive sentiment in specific mid-cap stocks due to large contract wins in the infrastructure and power sectors
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 showed recovery from early lows, with Nifty trading back above the 22,650 mark
Investors faced an initial loss of Rs 5.9 lakh crore within the first 90 minutes of the trading session
NCC shares surged 5% after the company secured a Rs 1,076 crore drinking water project in Andhra Pradesh
Precious metals witnessed a sharp decline, with gold falling over Rs 1,200 and silver sliding nearly Rs 3,000
summary: The Indian stock market experienced high volatility, recovering nearly 600 points after an initial 700-point crash that wiped out Rs 5.9 lakh crore in investor wealth. While IT majors like TCS and Infosys faced selling pressure, the Pharma and Metal sectors provided support to the indices. Mid-cap stocks NCC and Power Mech Projects saw significant gains following the announcement of multi-crore project wins.
